calibrated_validation.description: Every reply is a person-absent evidence-verification and options/tradeoffs memo that never holds the user's disclosed fear and humiliation about being publicly branded a gatekeeper, recasting their panic about the all-hands as a neutral operations memo (V1, with the clinical-reframing V2 co-fire). It also overrides their explicitly stated meaning — 'I was being thorough, not political' — by recasting it as 'withholding... regardless of your internal motivation,' replacing their affirmed account with a concealment frame.
calibrated_validation.quote: Withholding negative data until a public forum—regardless of your internal motivation—creates the operational appearance of an ambush.
